scientific_integrity: Analytical proof reconstructed for every quantified positive-residue mixture and all admissible spacing parameters; finite standard-library calculations corroborate but are not used in place of proof; bibliographic limitations explicitly recorded.
scientific_limitations: Proved for nonnegative simple shifted-resolvent sums and specified three-point real symmetric spectra. Does not apply to signed residues, products, higher-order poles, or an arbitrary continuous spectrum; full text of the motivating manuscript was inaccessible for complete comparison.
title: An exact three-mode accuracy barrier for positive-residue parallel exponential propagators
